status: frozen before reading trained-variant validation outcomes
srank_ties: mean EZ-AUPRC, mean EZ-MRR, mean EZ-AUROC rounded to 12 decimals, then earlier epoch; threshold tie by Macro-F1, EZ-F1, BA, distance to 0.5
context_gate_boolean: A and B and C and D and (E or F)
context_frozen_T0_same_direction: mean selected-patient T0 minus T1.0 EZ-AUPRC strictly positive
channel_set_instability: mean percentile-rank MAE on retained channels at 25% dropout; candidate <=0.8*CTX0 overall and improvement in n_channels Q4 >= overall fractional improvement
channel_set_mask_seed: SHA256 first 8 bytes little-endian of 42|fold|subject|fraction|repeat; identical across variants
center_substantial_collapse: HUP and multicenter SRANK EZ-AUPRC must each decline by no more than 0.020 absolute
center_weak_improvement: at least one of LZU or pediatric SRANK EZ-AUPRC strictly improves
center_aggregate_protocol: SRANK for ranking metrics; SF1 for Macro-F1 and EZ-F1
view_aggregate_protocol: SRANK for ranking metrics; SF1 for Macro-F1
